reviews.review_msg: Very poor lecture skills, the pace is agonizingly slow however none of the challenging technical details are ever covered. The assignments spoon feed everything to you to the point you do not actually learn anything from them. If you are able to avoid taking this course by replacing it I would highly recommend doing so.

Jinko is an incredible professor. I am really enjoying her class. She explains the concepts really well, and the class generally is very organized in terms of homeworks and projects, and things we need to do. She makes really good assignments that help with learning a lot. I highly recommend taking a class with her if you have the chance to.
